    result = String(java.hexDecodeToString(result));
    result = JSON.parse(result);

    if (source.getVariable() == '2') {
        let ck69 = String(cookie.getCookie('https://www.69shuba.com'));
        let headers = {
            "Cookie": ck69
        };
        let op = JSON.stringify({
            "headers": headers
        });
        let sbdetailurl = `https://www.69shuba.com/book/${result.bookid}.htm`;

        html = java.ajax(sbdetailurl + ',' + op);

        if (html.includes("Just a moment...")) {
            cookie.removeCookie('https://www.69shuba.com');
            java.longToast('需要真人验证，请进入任意书籍详情页过验证');
            var s = java.startBrowserAwait(sbdetailurl, "需要真人验证，请进入任意书籍详情页过验证").body();
            let newCk69 = String(cookie.getCookie('https://www.69shuba.com'));
            let newHeaders = {
                "Cookie": newCk69
            };
            let newOp = JSON.stringify({
                "headers": newHeaders
            });
            html = java.ajax(sbdetailurl + ',' + newOp);
        }
    }
    let postOp = {
        method: "POST",
        body: {
            html: html
        }
    };
    //java.log('html'+html)

    res = java.ajax(source.bookSourceUrl + `/detail?bookid=${result.bookid},` + JSON.stringify(postOp));
}
</js>$.data

ruleContent.content:
<js>
result = JSON.parse(String(java.hexDecodeToString(result)));
let content_url = `/content?bookid=${result.bookid}&itemid=${result.itemid}`;
let retry = source.getVariable();

if (retry == '1') {
    content_url = content_url + '&retry=1';
} else if (retry == '2') {
    let ck69 = String(cookie.getCookie('https://www.69shuba.com'));
    let headers = {
        "Cookie": ck69
    };
    let op = JSON.stringify({
        "headers": headers
    });
    let sbdetailurl = `https://www.69shuba.com/text/${result.bookid}/${result.itemid}`;

    let html = java.ajax(sbdetailurl + ',' + op);

    if (html.includes("Just a moment...")) {
        cookie.removeCookie('https://www.69shuba.com');
        java.longToast('需要真人验证，请进入任意书籍详情页过验证');
        var s = java.startBrowserAwait(sbdetailurl, "需要真人验证，请进入任意书籍详情页过验证").body();
        let newCk69 = String(cookie.getCookie('https://www.69shuba.com'));
        let newHeaders = {
            "Cookie": newCk69
        };
        let newOp = JSON.stringify({
            "headers": newHeaders
        });
        html = java.ajax(sbdetailurl + ',' + newOp);
    }
    
    let postOp = {
        method: "POST", 
        body: {
            html: html
        }
    };
    content_url = `${content_url},${JSON.stringify(postOp)}`;
}

let response = java.ajax(source.bookSourceUrl + content_url);
result = JSON.parse(response).data;

function cleanChapterText(text) {
    if (!text) return '';
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    const filteredLines = lines.filter(line => {
        return !(line.includes('第') && line.includes('章')) && 
               !line.includes('作者：') &&
               !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(line.trim());
    });
    return filteredLines.join('\n');
}

result = cleanChapterText(result);
</js>

bookInfoRule.init:
<js>
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var og = (selector) =>
  J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content');

var book = {
  name: og('novel:book_name'),
  author: og('novel:author'),
  kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status'),
  latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name') + ' • ' + String(og('novel:update_time')).replace(/(\d+:\d+)/,''),
  cover: og('image').replace('https','http'),
  wordCount: J.select('.layui-bg-red').text(),
  intro: J.select('.intro p').eq(0).html(),
  url:og('novel:read_url').replace('m.','www.')
};

book;
</js>
